settings.title: Pick your meals
settings.text: A new menu goes up every week. Choose your meals and your base, then check out online.

settings.text: Grab your order from the cooler at Ironsmith's Gym, or have it brought to your door.

settings.heading: Two easy ways to get your meals

settings.q: When do I need to order by?
settings.a: Thursday at 6 PM for meals the following Tuesday. The countdown at the top of the site always shows the next cut-off.

settings.q: When do I get my meals?
settings.a: Tuesday, either delivered to your door or ready in the cooler at Ironsmith's Gym, 1714 E Main St, Crawfordsville.
Every week. A new menu goes up each week, and favourites come back around.

settings.q: How do I heat a meal?
settings.a: Keep meals refrigerated. Microwave for 2 to 3 minutes and enjoy.
No. Everything is chef-prepared with fresh, never-frozen ingredients.

settings.q: Can I add a note to my order?
settings.a: Yes. Open your cart and use "Order special instructions", or call or text (317) 294-2433.
